hero.headline: Telematics Engineer & Systems N2 / Cloud Intern
hero.headlineSub: Systems, Cloud, Full-Stack and XR developer tools
hero.aboutMe: Telematics Engineer from URJC, graduated in January 2026, with experience in software development, systems, and data visualization. Author of Code-XR, an open-source VS Code extension published at IEEE VISSOFT 2025, focused on visual analysis of code metrics in XR environments. Currently finishing an extracurricular internship in Cloud & Systems N2 (March-August 2026) and incoming student of the Master's Degree in Telecommunication Engineering at UPM, specializing in Machine Learning and Big Data, with interest in software analytics, code repositories, and applied research.

about.title: About me
about.p1: I am a Telematics Engineering student (URJC) and the author of Code-XR, an ecosystem that connects static analysis with immersive visualization of metrics.
about.p2: Our work has been accepted for VISSOFT 2025 (co-located with ICSME 2025). I am preparing the thesis and consolidating documentation and tooling for its evolution.
about.p3: I care about clean code, modular architecture, and a strong DX/UX. I aim for systems that scale and can be maintained.

profile.title: About Me
profile.subtitle: A clearer view of where my engineering profile is heading
profile.name: Adrián Montes Linares
profile.role: Telematics Engineer with experience in Cloud, Systems N2, Full-Stack development, and XR software visualization
profile.bio1: I am a Telematics Engineer from Universidad Rey Juan Carlos, graduated in January 2026. My profile combines software development, systems, cloud operations, and data visualization, with a practical focus on maintainable tools and clear documentation.
profile.bio2: I am currently finishing an extracurricular internship at SATEC in Cloud & Systems N2, working around support requests, incidents, infrastructure operation, virtual machines, vulnerability patching, SSH/RDP access, and tools such as Nagios, AMS, Veeam Backup, NetApp, and VMware.

stats.experienceValue: SATEC Cloud & Systems N2, VBGroup Full-Stack internship, Code-XR, VISSOFT 2025
stats.educationValue: Telematics Engineering (URJC, Jan 2026), Telecom Engineering master at UPM from Sep 2026
stats.focusValue: Systems, cloud, developer tooling, XR visualization, Machine Learning, and Big Data
stats.languagesValue: Spanish native, English B2 TOEIC, preparing C1
stats.mindsetValue: Technical curiosity, Quality-driven approach, Continuous learning

profile.bio3: Before that, during my curricular internship at VBGroup, I worked as a Junior Full-Stack Developer on OBT, an internal platform built with Express.js, TypeScript, Cosmos DB, Azure Blob Storage, React, Vite, and Tailwind. My next academic step is the Master's Degree in Telecommunication Engineering at UPM, with a specialization path in Machine Learning and Big Data.
profile.snapshotBody: Systems and cloud give me operational depth; full-stack development gives me product delivery; XR, software analytics, Machine Learning, and Big Data define the research and tooling direction I want to keep building.
